description.value: The study compared prescription opioid users with chronic pain and healthy controls using resting-state functional connectivity and voxel-based morphometry, examining frontostriatal abnormalities and their associations with affect, opioid misuse, and pain.

spans.text: The current study utilized functional and structural imaging techniques to compare a group of prescription opioid users with chronic pain (OUG) ( N =31) to drug-free healthy controls ( N =30).

value: We hypothesized that prescription opioid users with chronic pain, as compared to healthy control subjects, would evidence weaker frontostriatal rsFC and less frontostriatal gray matter volume (GMV).
